title: GrowWithHR Code on Wages Wave 5C Governed Source-Readiness Catalogue

sourcePack.name: GrowWithHR Code on Wages source-readiness snapshot
sourcePack.notes: Wave 5C uses seven controlled official source identities. Existing Wave 5A Code, Central Rules and Ministry-jurisdiction identities are reused; commencement, corrigendum and notification-register identities are source-readiness records only. Exact current full controlled files and State/UT wage instruments remain separate source-hardening dependencies.

limitations: The Wave 5C catalogue remains needs-legal-review and is not an applicable minimum-wage, wage-rate, wage-category, zone, scheduled-employment, payroll, entitlement or remedy determination.

Only organisation-level declared source route, source-readiness, commencement, version, jurisdiction-routing, bounded rate-register, State-instrument-register and specialist-escalation statuses plus controlled references are eligible for retrieval context.

Retrieval cannot choose the appropriate Government, select a numeric rate, category, zone, scheduled employment or State instrument, perform payroll arithmetic, determine individual amounts due or change the deterministic decision.
Source-identity fingerprints identify curated official records only and do not approve the full current file set, State/UT source packs or legal interpretation.

chunks.title: Code on Wages source identity
chunks.sectionReference: Code on Wages, 2019 — official source identity
chunks.text: The Code on Wages, 2019 is a controlled source identity for Wave 5C. Its presence supports organisation-level source-readiness review only and does not select an employee's minimum wage, wage rate, wage category, zone, scheduled employment, deduction, overtime, bonus, entitlement or remedy.

chunks.title: Early commencement source
chunks.text: S.O. 4604(E), dated 18 December 2020, is retained as a commencement and transition source for the Code on Wages. Wave 5C uses it only to maintain a versioned commencement register; it does not independently determine the current rule applicable to a customer or employee.

chunks.title: Principal commencement source
chunks.text: S.O. 5322(E), dated 21 November 2025, is retained as a principal Code on Wages commencement source. Retrieval may explain that this instrument belongs in the controlled commencement set, but only the deterministic source-readiness rule may select status and no model may choose an applicable wage obligation.

chunks.title: Central Rules source identity
chunks.text: The Code on Wages (Central) Rules, 2026 are registered as the current Central Rules source identity for the private-beta source-readiness review. Central Rules do not by themselves establish that the Central Government sphere, a particular wage rate, category, zone or State instrument applies to an organisation or individual.

chunks.title: Central Rules corrigendum and version control
chunks.text: The July 2026 corrigendum to the Code on Wages (Central) Rules, 2026 is a required version-control companion source. Wave 5C records whether the corrigendum is included in the controlled source set and does not interpret the correction as an employee-level wage or entitlement decision.

chunks.title: Appropriate-Government routing boundary
chunks.text: Code on Wages source readiness requires a controlled appropriate-Government routing step. A declared central, state, mixed or unresolved route is an organisation-level input only; retrieval and provider output cannot choose the applicable Government or infer jurisdiction from customer data.

chunks.title: Bounded rate-source register
chunks.sectionReference: Ministry Code on Wages notifications register
chunks.text: The Ministry's Code on Wages notification register is used only to verify that bounded rate and implementation source routes are maintained. Wave 5C does not retrieve a numeric rate for decision-making, choose a category or zone, map scheduled employment, or calculate payroll, overtime, deductions or bonus.

chunks.title: State and Union Territory source-pack boundary
chunks.text: State and Union Territory wage instruments remain separate governed-source dependencies. A complete Wave 5C result means the organisation has recorded source-routing and escalation controls; it does not mean any State instrument, minimum wage category, rate, zone or scheduled employment has been selected.

chunks.title: Version and specialist-escalation controls
chunks.text: Effective-date, amendment, commencement, corrigendum and specialist-escalation controls must remain explicit and versioned. Missing or conflicting controlled sources remain specialist-review dependencies, and missing required organisation facts remain more-information-needed.
